g.text: 3. Orchestrator runs Harbor in the cloud (run API key)
for each trial, n_concurrent at a time
resolve ${VAR} secrets from the env and .env
local Docker: build or pull every image the
suites use, for linux/amd64, then docker save
mint a short-lived run API key
exits: the machine can go offline
results: a new evaluation per suite in the Laminar UI
solid = request, dashed = response; every sandbox call goes through the app-server, so Daytona and ECR credentials never leave it
